subject.title: feat(chat): rewind and fork a session from a message bubble

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `sessions.rewind` and `sessions.fork` as public gateway operations and ship per-message Control UI recovery actions once the session-state defects are repaired?
rationale: The branch adds a new user-facing recovery mode and public protocol/API surface rather than repairing an established broken contract; maintainers must choose the permanent product and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the feature with repairs
options.body: Keep the feature direction, require the three correctness fixes and live Control UI proof, then review the gateway contract as a stable supported surface.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Retain the UI experiment but redesign or defer one or both public RPCs until the desired plugin/gateway ownership contract is agreed.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR if the recovery workflow is not currently a supported product priority despite its implementation value.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the feature with repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, require the three correctness fixes and live Control UI proof, then review the gateway contract as a stable supported surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this person to the proposed implementation; confidence is low because current-main feature-history ownership could not be established from the available read-only evidence.
